title: Martijn van der Most vs Niklas Fritschen
matchup: Magnus · Grand Coven vs Chaos Daemons · Legion of Excess / Warptide
result: Thousand Sons win · 99–38 VP / 20–0 team points
dateNote: 36 days before this 19 September review. Broadcast and YouTube upload dates both 14 August; edition confirmed by the WTC event pack.
notes: 32 sampled timestamps, eight published checkpoints and one partial roster card. At 09:40:00 the named match row is 99–38 / 20–0. Do not read the bottom eight-game team aggregate as this game’s score. Unit-level casualty and ability claims remain unverified.

lessons.text: Keep an outside lane available for Magnus. His sampled positions move from left-middle to upper-left and then upper-centre while the main Daemon mass is on the right.
Keep scoring units separate from the main monster fight. TS infantry persist on left-side lanes when large Daemons converge on Magnus at the top and another group presses the bottom.
Convert the spread into late board presence. TS models occupy centre and right by 09:30, followed by a 99–38 closing score. The precise arrival rule and casualty sequence remain unknown.

tracking.method: Coarse contact sheet, then denser samples around first contact, major relocation, removal and closing score. Selected full-resolution frames inspected. Generic groups are not tracked as individual units; arrows only join confident visual re-identifications.

analysis.heading: What happened
analysis.text: 14 August 2026 · 11th edition · 99–38 VP, 20–0 team points. Van der Most has Magnus, ten Scarabs, Vortex Prince, three led Rubric squads and four small Enlightened units. Fritschen has sixty Daemonettes and fifteen Fiends, plus Keeper, chariot and characters. Magnus works an outside lane while smaller TS groups remain spread across separate pockets. This provides a different response to pressure from one compact central castle.

analysis.heading: Magnus opening and later movement
analysis.text: At 06:40 Magnus is left-middle. By 07:00 he is behind the far-left ruin; by 08:00 he is in the upper lane as TS lead 39–16. These are observed early/later positions, not a verified pregame deployment. At 08:20 large Daemon models converge toward him while other pressure develops below.

analysis.heading: What is known about reserves
analysis.text: The full roster confirms ten Scarabs and a Terminator Sorcerer. Crystal is on the Infernal Master, not the Terminator leader. A TS group appears far right by 08:55, but neither its unit identity nor its arrival mechanism is proven. Starting reserves, exact arrival turns and first actions remain unknown. The list does not license calling that movement a Scarab Crystal play.

analysis.heading: Transfer to your list
analysis.text: Keep a side exit and firing lane for Magnus while other units contest the board. Your Crystal is on the Terminator leader and your small-unit count is lower, so you cannot simply copy the Rubric teleport threat and four Enlightened units from this roster.
